items.claim: AI smarter than the smartest human by the end of 2025, and within two years at most
items.quote: If you define AGI as smarter than the smartest human, I think it's probably next year, within two years
items.where: Live interview on X with Nicolai Tangen of Norges Bank Investment Management
items.when: probably next year, within two years

source.title: Elon Musk: AI will be smarter than any human around the end of next year

items.test: Right if, by the end of April 2026, at least one AI system is credibly shown, by independent evaluation rather than its maker's claims, to be smarter than the smartest human across essentially all intellectual work; partly if AI clearly out-performs the best human experts in several major fields but not across the board.
items.finding: By the end of April 2026 no AI system had been shown to be smarter than the smartest human across the board. Stanford's 2026 AI Index found frontier models meeting or exceeding human baselines on PhD-level science questions, multimodal reasoning and competition mathematics, while the top model read analogue clocks correctly only 50.1% of the time. In January 2026 Musk himself said AI smarter than any human might arrive by the end of 2026.

evidence.title: Elon Musk Predicts AI Will Outpace Human Intelligence as Early as This Year

items.claim: Neuralink starts high-volume production of its brain implants, with an almost entirely automated surgery, in 2026
items.quote: Neuralink will start high-volume production of brain-computer interface devices and move to a streamlined, almost entirely automated surgical procedure in 2026

source.title: Neuralink to kick-start 'high-volume production' of brain-computer interface devices, Elon Musk says

items.test: Right if, by the end of December 2026, Neuralink is making its implants in volume (at least hundreds a year) and implanting them with a procedure performed almost entirely by its surgical robot; partly if only one of the two has happened by then.

items.test: Right if, by the end of December 2031, independent evaluations show AI systems doing more, and better, intellectual work than all of humanity together, for example out-producing the entire human research community in science and engineering; partly if, by then, AI clearly exceeds the best individual humans across essentially all intellectual work but not humanity as a whole.

source.title: Elon Musk Says Work will be optional in 20 years

items.test: Right if, by the end of November 2045, at least one major economy gives everyone a good standard of living whether or not they work, with AI and robots doing most of the work, so that paid work is a choice for most adults; partly if, by then, this holds only in smaller economies or for a minority of adults.

items.test: Right if, by the end of December 2040, credible counts (such as the International Federation of Robotics or national statistics) put the number of humanoid robots in use above the world's human population; partly if, by then, at least a billion humanoid robots are in use.
